verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly market 'Approve the big calls from your phone' with decisions landing in one approvals list, and describe approval as a deliberate human gate before agents act, which directly matches the story. However, evidence is all first-party marketing/docs with no screenshots, mobile-web specifics, or independent hands-on confirmation of a phone-optimized approval flow. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the mobile approval UI, details on notification/alerting for pending approvals, and confirmation of responsive/native mobile support beyond a tagline.
